title: Bentness and duals of subspace-indicator sums
summary: Give an exact bentness criterion and dual formula for arbitrary source-admissible sums of subspace indicators added to a bent function.

formal_statement.body: Let $f$ be bent on $\mathbb F_2^n$, let $V_1,\ldots,V_\tau$ be binary linear subspaces, and let $a_i\in\mathbb F_2$. For the source function $$h(x)=f(x)+\sum_{i=1}^{\tau}a_i\mathbf 1_{V_i}(x),$$ give necessary and sufficient conditions covering every source-admissible tuple $(f,(V_i),(a_i))$ for $h$ to be bent, and compute the dual $h^*$ whenever those conditions hold.

scope.domain: Indicator perturbations of Boolean bent functions
assumptions: f is a Boolean bent function
Each V_i is a binary linear subspace
h is exactly Equation (16) of the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source proves sufficient conditions and the corresponding dual under second-derivative restrictions. No later result found in the audit supplies an if-and-only-if criterion and dual for every admissible indicator-sum tuple.

progress.summary: The source asks for a full necessary-and-sufficient condition and the dual after proving only a sufficient condition for the general indicator sum.
